CHPL_COMM=none
CHPL_TASKS=qthreads
CHPL_UNWIND=system

CHPL_TARGET_MEM=jemalloc
CHPL_ATOMICS=cstdlib
CHPL_GMP=system
CHPL_HWLOC=system
